style.vernacular: Equatorial garden city: 10-50 storey HDB public-housing slabs and point blocks in pastel painted render (cream, pale yellow, peach, pale green-blue) with flat roofs, open void decks and long common corridors; low-rise terraced shophouses with five-foot-way arcades, pastel facades and red clay-tile pitched roofs; colonial black-and-white bungalows and Palladian civic buildings in white stucco; glass-and-steel towers downtown. Heavy tropical planting: rain trees, palms, frangipani.
style.ornament: Five-foot-way arcades and Peranakan glazed tiles on shophouses; louvred shutters, deep verandahs and Palladian columns on colonial buildings; Art Deco horizontal fins and dated plaques at Tiong Bahru; HDB block-number plates, void decks, colour-banded corridors; lush vertical greenery on newer towers.

sources.what: shophouses with five-foot ways, Malay stilt houses, black-and-white bungalows, Palladian/neoclassical civic buildings, Art Deco, HDB slab blocks
